title: TinkerPop rejects a second projection on one dedup step
summary: Two projections on one dedup step returned all six Modern graph names on the parent. The merge threw IllegalStateException during the second by() call. Putting the name projection on its own dedup step restored a valid traversal with the same four people on both revisions.

change.description: A global deduplication step rejects a second projection during composition.

notes: The application uses the embedded TinkerGraph built at the same commit as gremlin-core. It sorts the returned name multiset after iteration and separately records the phase of an exception.
